observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment authority check and environmental-capability projection

outcome.observed_limit: The recorded merge preflight was denied because a repository-relative claim overlapped the selected checkout. The projection's later point-in-time lifecycle lookup classified that claim as stale and recoverable, while the owner session lifecycle still read active.
outcome.interpretation: A persistent claim record acted as an integration gate even though the Environment could separately expose stale and recoverable claim state. This is coordination state being treated as exclusive integration authority.
outcome.analysis_limit: The lifecycle lookup is point-in-time and does not establish the owner's process state at denial time. No Git merge or publication was attempted by this preflight.

related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: Improve MNCS's ability to understand and improve how effectively its language, compiler, tooling, and environment serve and potentiate agents. Use provenance-linked observations from authentic development to relate agent objectives, capability implementation, discoverability and use, environmental conditions, language and compiler pressures, verification, and outcomes. Make remaining host implementations and native opportunities inspectable only where authoritative evidence supports them. Treat usage and resource measures as diagnostic evidence, not agent scores or adoption targets. Preserve uncertainty, respect active compiler ownership, and verify environmental changes independently through existing mechanisms.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Persistent claim overlap blocks scoped integration preflight
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment authority evaluation for merge and publish
pressure_hypothesis.basis: An authenticated merge denial identified an overlapping repository-relative claim. A current claim-state projection classified the record as stale and recoverable, yet the denial path still treated overlap as an integration veto.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Separate integration eligibility from persistent claim ownership: evaluate writable repository rights and exact observed operation scope, retain overlapping claims as coordination evidence, and rely on repository-native concurrent ref updates for actual integration.
